claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius under standard atmospheric pressure.
description: Thermodynamic physical chemistry law confirmed by NIST, IAPWS, and fundamental physics benchmarks.

claim: Vaccines contain microchips to secretly track citizens.
description: Widely circulated viral rumor refuted by microscopic spectroscopy, physical needle dimensions, and health regulatory bodies.

claim: Drinking coffee significantly reduces the risk of heart disease.
description: Observational cohort studies show modest long-term benefits for moderate filtered coffee, but clinical trials show blood pressure spikes, lipid increases from cafestol, and adverse effects in slow metabolizers.

claim: Extraterrestrial beings established a secret hyper-quantum base beneath Mount Vinson in 1947.
description: Speculative claim lacking any verifiable empirical documentation or peer-reviewed polar scientific literature.
